decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed house, by reason of its size, position and appearance would represent an incongruous and unsympathetic development, out of keeping with the scale, character and pattern of development in the area, in particular due to its bulky crown roof and excessive width fronting Jersey Road. The proposal would therefore represent an unacceptable form of infill development and a cramped overdevelopment of the site, which would harm the appearance of the street scene, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development), H.1.1 (Location of New Housing Development) and H.6.3 (Backland / Infill development)

Condition : 2 - The proposed house, by reason of its size, bulk, position forward of the building line of the cul-de-sac, and its relative position to neighbouring properties; would represent an obtrusive and unneighbourly development which would further enclose this cramped cul-de-sac, and would harm the living conditions of adjoining occupiers, by reason of enclosure and loss of outlook, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New development), H.1.1 (Location of New Housing Development) and H.6.3 (Backland / Infill development)
description: Erection of a three bedroom detached house with associated parking and landscaping.
